scope.summary: Author the shoulder frame channels per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-042), closing OBR-002 verbatim: shoulder_frame_width (Skeletal: clavicle length/frame) and shoulder_softness (Tissue: deltoid/trap muscle-tone softening), fully independent of ALL breast, chest-circumference, and ribcage channels in both directions. The signature archetype — narrow soft shoulders + huge tits, dialed to emphasize the tits even more — is a canonical BodyKit acceptance test.
acceptance_criteria: shoulder_frame_width is registered kind Skeletal (drives clavicle bone scale/placement via the 13.18 joint re-derivation lane) and shoulder_softness kind Tissue (deltoid/trap mask), group_key 'shoulder'.

No registry row, coupling link, or code path drives any shoulder channel from any breast/chest/ribcage channel or vice versa; a negative test asserts the coupling graph is empty between the 'breast' and 'shoulder' groups by default.

Signature archetype test: shoulder_frame_width at min + shoulder_softness at max + breast_volume at 3.0 evaluates artifact-free (mesh quality assertions) and BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID stays green for all involved channels.

Dialing breast_volume across its full range produces exactly 0.0 mm displacement on shoulder-mask vertices, and dialing shoulder channels produces 0.0 mm on breast-mask vertices (bidirectional independence proof).
Both channels are API-addressable with correct ranges; shoulder_frame_width documents its skeletal propagation semantics in the registry row.
scope.risk_if_missed: OBR-002 is the operator's named founding pain: Daz's ERC-linked full-body morphs make narrow-shoulders + huge-tits fight itself. If shoulder width is even indirectly coupled to bust, the signature production archetype fails and the decoupling promise is visibly hollow.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Separate control independence from declared feathered deformation support, skeletal propagation, physical response, and explicit coupling.
